description: This file defines a singleton class TraceLogger used for logging various user interactions and system events within the Calculator application's ViewModel. It includes enums for UI elements and a struct for button logs, facilitating detailed trace logging for debugging and analytics.

classes.name: TraceLogger
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for logging various events and states within the calculator application, including user interactions, system states, and errors.

classes.name: ButtonLog
classes.description: A struct representing a log entry for button usage, including the button identifier, mode, and usage count.

methods.name: GetInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of TraceLogger.

methods.name: LogModeChange
methods.description: Logs a change in the application's view mode.

methods.name: LogHistoryItemLoad
methods.description: Logs the loading of a history item, including mode, list size, and index.

methods.name: LogMemoryItemLoad
methods.description: Logs the loading of a memory item, including mode, list size, and index.

methods.name: UpdateButtonUsage
methods.description: Updates the usage count for a specific button in a given mode.

methods.name: LogButtonUsage
methods.description: Logs usage of a button.

methods.name: LogDateCalculationModeUsed
methods.description: Logs whether date calculation mode (Add/Subtract) was used.

methods.name: UpdateWindowCount
methods.description: Updates the count of open windows.

methods.name: DecreaseWindowCount
methods.description: Decreases the window count.

methods.name: IsWindowIdInLog
methods.description: Checks if a window ID is already logged.

methods.name: LogVisualStateChanged
methods.description: Logs changes in visual state, including mode, state string, and topmost status.

methods.name: LogWindowCreated
methods.description: Logs creation of a new window with mode and window ID.

methods.name: LogConverterInputReceived
methods.description: Logs when converter input is received.

methods.name: LogNavBarOpened
methods.description: Logs when the navigation bar is opened.

methods.name: LogError
methods.description: Logs an error with mode, function name, and error string.

methods.name: LogShowHideButtonClicked
methods.description: Logs when show/hide button is clicked.

methods.name: LogGraphButtonClicked
methods.description: Logs when a graph button is clicked, including button name and value.

methods.name: LogGraphLineStyleChanged
methods.description: Logs changes to graph line style.

methods.name: LogVariableChanged
methods.description: Logs variable changes.

methods.name: LogVariableSettingsChanged
methods.description: Logs changes to variable settings.

methods.name: LogGraphSettingsChanged
methods.description: Logs changes to graph settings.

methods.name: LogGraphTheme
methods.description: Logs changes to the graph theme.

methods.name: LogInputPasted
methods.description: Logs when input is pasted.

methods.name: LogPlatformExceptionInfo
methods.description: Logs platform exception details.

methods.name: LogRecallSnapshot
methods.description: Logs recall snapshot events.

methods.name: LogRecallRestore
methods.description: Logs recall restore events.

methods.name: LogRecallError
methods.description: Logs recall errors.

methods.name: LogPlatformException
methods.description: Logs platform exceptions.

methods.name: LogStandardException
methods.description: Logs standard C++ exceptions.

methods.name: TraceLogger (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes the singleton TraceLogger instance.
